title: Litter palette: current browns vs a warmer, lighter set
question: You said on the invisible-floor card that a different colour would settle it. Here it is, blind. But read the caveat first: after this merge litter rots, so the floor sits at ~1,000 cells instead of ~12,000, and neither option makes much of a mat. Is the palette the problem, or is the floor simply too thin now?
context_md: Same scene, same frame, same seed -- only litter.ron's six colours differ. Forest floor at frame 11,000, cropped to the soil surface at 11x zoom.\n\n**Caveat that may matter more than the colours.** The invisible-floor complaint was raised when a standing forest held ~12,000 litter cells and climbing. Litter now weathers back to soil, so the same scene settles at ~1,000 -- 81% of everything shed rots away. If the floor reads as thin rather than as the wrong colour, the lever is the rot rate, not the palette.
